editorial_notes: CN is the primary meaning source; EN is used for character names and structure. The sources are different Git blobs, so they are not byte-identical.
All 83 dialogue positions and all three choice-command positions match between CN and EN. Five options translated, preserving each Predicate/values branch.
CN line 26 says the speaker does not regret killing him regardless of what he carried; RU avoids inventing a specific crime or burden.
CN #34 says 'I am too weak' while EN uses 'pathetic'; RU follows the CN assessment.
CN #61 means 'take him back' rather than EN's added 'home'; RU omits the destination.
CN #54 asks LGD not to slacken vigilance, while EN says not to panic; RU follows CN.
CN uses {@Nickname} on one line whereas EN uses {@nickname}; RU preserves the actual EN game variable spelling.
No original full CN/EN story scripts are committed. Preview builder validates Git blob revisions and only changes dialogue labels/text and declared Decision option strings.
First draft only, not verified in Yostar PC client.
